newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Cleveland City School Dist., Ohio.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Cleveland City School Dist., Ohio.

text.p: On behalf of the Cleveland City School District, Banc One Capital Corporation (Financial Advisor) requests bids for the above referenced issue. Questions regarding the District or structure of the transaction may be directed to Daniel F. Rohr by calling 800-837-5111 or 614-217-1051. Legal
questions may be directed to Jonathon Buchter by calling 216-479-8513. Any party interested in receiving a Disclosure Document and bidding information regarding the above

referenced transaction should indicate its interest in writing to the offices of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey, 4900 Society Center, 127 Public Square, Cleveland, Ohio 44114, Attention: Jonathon Buchter (fax numbers 216-479-8787, - 8780, or -8781) by 3:00 p.m. eastern time on May 5, 1997. Bids will be received at 11:00 a.m. eastern time on May 13, 1997. The transaction is scheduled to settle on May 22, 1997.
*Amount subject to change due to fluctuations in price of
